closureCensus.interpretation: All frozen shipped-v18 responsibilities now have meaningful T3 functional/integration/end-to-end ownership. T4-T10 are not implied and remain separately governed.

CAP-CACHE-CONTROLS.rationale: The canonical HTTP workflow clears and refreshes cache through the real authenticated application routes and verifies running-demo rehydration.

CAP-DATA-ENGINE-MANUAL-REFRESH.rationale: The canonical HTTP workflow executes every targeted Data Engine refresh plus global/capability/VIX/stream actions through production handlers.

CAP-MAINTENANCE-INTEGRITY.rationale: The canonical HTTP workflow runs Maintenance and validates real check/failure output; integrity behavior remains owned by the same Maintenance path.

CAP-OPEN-EXTERNAL-URL.rationale: Renderer functional evidence proves user-facing external-link actions use the canonical /api/app/open-url path; native shell execution remains T9 platform evidence.

CAP-PROFILE-EXPORT-IMPORT.rationale: The real authenticated HTTP workflow exports a profile, verifies secret exclusion, imports it, and confirms permanent workspace structures survive.

CAP-PROVIDER-TEST.rationale: The real HTTP workflow invokes provider tests and accepts only truthful connected/missing/failed/not-configured/unavailable states.

CORE-PROVIDER-DATA-RIGHTS.rationale: This non-user-visible fail-closed egress boundary is directly executed by provider-rights and AI rights fixtures; it is intentionally not satisfied by a decorative UI route.

CORE-PROVIDER-TELEMETRY.rationale: The dedicated renderer functional owner proves privileged transport telemetry projection from canonical runtime state.

CORE-PROVIDER-USEFULNESS.rationale: The dedicated renderer functional owner proves semantic usefulness remains privileged, ADVISORY ONLY, and explicitly has no routing effect.

CORE-USER-WORKSPACE-ISOLATION.rationale: The real multi-user HTTP workflow proves distinct principals and user-scoped ticker state without cross-user workspace mutation.

PROVIDER-AI-GEMINI.rationale: Current functional Go evidence exercises strict structured provider payload handling and rights/safety boundaries for configured AI providers without live CI calls.

PROVIDER-AI-GROQ.rationale: Current functional AI routing/evidence tests exercise configured-provider selection, schema validation, cache identity, safety and abstention behavior.

PROVIDER-AI-OPENROUTER.rationale: Current functional AI routing/evidence tests exercise automatic/manual routing, strict output validation and bounded evidence behavior.

RELEASE-DEVELOPER-SCHEMA-PROBE.rationale: The developer probe is an executable release-support command with direct tests for explicit opt-in, redaction, argument rejection and fail-closed probe errors.

RELEASE-FAST.rationale: Canonical CI Fast records an exact-head success status and cannot dispatch release publication.

RELEASE-IDENTITY-PROVENANCE.rationale: Current release support verifies Git-object source provenance and exact-head release-state topology before publication.

RELEASE-MACOS-APPLE-SILICON.rationale: Canonical Qualified owns the independent macOS native rehearsal path; actual exact-head native execution is reserved for T9.

RELEASE-NO-REBUILD.rationale: The release rehearsal directly enforces same-run/no-rebuild publication topology and candidate-head binding.

RELEASE-QUALIFIED.rationale: Canonical Qualified is the executable exact-head cross-platform/browser/backend qualification workflow.

RELEASE-RENDERER-CHROME-WEBKIT.rationale: Canonical Qualified independently owns Chrome and WebKit renderer/browser qualification.

RELEASE-TEST-PROFILE-MIGRATION.rationale: Direct regression evidence proves test-profile identity cloning does not mutate Stable and the interactive auth copy preserves durable Stable-profile continuity.

RELEASE-WINDOWS-X64.rationale: Canonical Qualified owns the independent Windows native rehearsal path; actual exact-head native execution is reserved for T9.

SECURITY-ADMIN-AUTHORITY.rationale: Real HTTP and renderer workflows prove authorized admin access and fail-closed USER denial across direct routes and navigation.

SECURITY-AUTH-SESSIONS.rationale: The real application workflow exercises bootstrap credential setup, login, session rotation, logout and successful re-login.

SECURITY-IDENTITY-MODEL.rationale: The real application workflow creates a lower-role user and proves principal identities remain distinct across workspace operations.

SECURITY-REAUTH.rationale: The owner reauthenticates through the production /api/auth/reauth path before sensitive administration workflow.

SECURITY-SECRETS.rationale: The authenticated HTTP workflow exercises secret clearing and verifies profile export excludes credential material.

SHELL-IDENTITY-SIGNOUT.rationale: The real HTTP workflow signs out, verifies authentication is gone, and proves credential-backed sign-in still works afterward.

SURF-ADMINISTRATION.rationale: Dedicated Administration rendering and real role-guarded admin routes are both exercised; USER/DEMO access fails closed.

SURF-AI-COPILOT.rationale: Acceptance and renderer workflows prove AI is an evidence-grounded second opinion and cannot mutate deterministic Action/Score or execute trades.

TRANSPORT-SSE-USER-EVENTS.rationale: The real authenticated workflow consumes /api/events and verifies a user-scoped bootstrap stream without principal/session record leakage.

completionCondition: All 180 effective shipped-v18 responsibilities resolve their T3 expectation and have at least one current meaningful realistic functional/integration/end-to-end owner; all declared gaps are closed; exact-head Fast and identical-head Qualified pass.
